responsibility: Collects the public prototypes for the TILE-Gx backend’s target helpers, expanders, assembly printers, and C preprocessor hook. It exposes interfaces for PIC/PC-relative address construction, constant and move expansion, unaligned access lowering, multiplication and compare/branch emission, atomic barriers, prologue/epilogue and return-address handling, instruction length/output hooks, profiling, and cpp builtins so the target implementation can be referenced across generated and handwritten source files.
